desc:
Play real, rated chess on Roblox against people from all over the world!

♟️ Rated online games in Bullet, Blitz and Rapid, across 9 time controls
🔍 Game Breakdown: every move labelled from Brilliant to Blunder, with your accuracy and the best move you missed, powered by Stockfish
🧩 15,000+ rated puzzles, a new Daily Puzzle every day, and Puzzle Sprint: how many can you solve in 3 minutes?
🤖 10 bots with real personalities, from Leo (just learned how the horse moves) to Margaret (40 years at the chess club)
📖 3,800+ openings recognised in your games
🏆 Leaderboards for Bullet, Blitz, Rapid, Puzzles and Sprint
🎨 Unlock new boards and piece sets

💡 New to chess? Start against Leo and work your way up!

👍 Like and ⭐ Favourite to get updates!
